subcategory_text: Privacy roles and responsibilities are coordinated and aligned with third-party stakeholders (e.g., service providers, customers, partners).
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PS-7 (External Personnel Security), SR-5 (Acquisition Strategies)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.SC-04 (supplier criticality assessed)
implementation_examples: Coordinate privacy roles and responsibilities with third-party stakeholders (service providers, customers, partners) through contracts, SLAs, and joint operating procedures
Document third-party point of contact and back-up for each privacy role
Re-examine coordination when relationships are added or terminated
assessment_objectives: Determine whether third-party stakeholders are mapped to corresponding privacy roles
Determine whether coordination mechanisms (contracts, SLAs, joint procedures) exist
Determine whether single points of failure are mitigated through back-up coverage
Determine whether coordination is refreshed on relationship changes
